authority: User supplied master scenario in current conversation; overrides all older notes, including earlier blanket nonhuman-boss rule.
deliverable: Exactly 8 single landscape boss concept shots: one representative key scene per Stage1-8. No T-poses, turnarounds, equipment sheets, map assets, UI, subtitles, layouts, or variant sheets.
commonStyle: Match the existing ASTELLA actor/character references: polished stylized 2D anime fantasy illustration, broad clean color shapes, ivory/navy/warm-gold visual language with per-stage accents, restrained texture and clear silhouettes. Stage settings may be dark and tragic while the subject remains readable. No photoreal gritty metal, no gore, no sexualized body treatment. Each frame one dominant boss in a characteristic emotional pose with a fitting arena background; full or nearly full major silhouette, weapon/wings not cropped. Landscape about3:2. No typographic labels or watermarks; essential in-world Roman numeral XIII allowed.
variableBossRule: Stages1-4 are the unselected jobs (DPS,DPS,healer,tank), not four permanently fixed classes. For these eight representative illustrations only, Stage1 uses archer/scout cues, Stage2 dual-blade cues, Stage3 alchemical-healer cues, Stage4 lance/shield-tank cues. Record these as visual examples; do not claim fixed canon class assignments.

stages.title: 기억을 흘리는 정찰병
stages.boss: Unselected DPS1, a still-recognizable human expedition companion infected with clockwork virus. Torso chest chamber has become a cracked glass hourglass inside a brass rib-frame, leaking GOLD SAND, never blood/organs.
stages.scene: 45m circular glass hourglass arena with THREE concentric rings, outer ring opens into deadly sand vortex, golden ceiling sand waterfalls and huge brass wall gears.
stages.pose: Low three-quarter view, poised scout with one bow held low and free hand extended toward absent comrades, torn cloak lifted by sand. Sorrow/recognition in human face; chest hourglass and escaping sand immediately legible. Body still half-human/half-machine, not generic faceless automaton.

stages.title: 끝나지 않는 진혼곡의 무희
stages.boss: Unselected DPS2, human expedition companion forced to dance by a HUGE golden wind-up key implanted in the upper back. Key must be a prominent tangible mechanism; clean metal mount through damaged costume, no graphic flesh.
stages.scene: 45m circular rotating music-box turntable, cathedral golden organ pipes and spiked music cylinders, eight musical-note tower pads around perimeter.
stages.pose: A strained elegant forced dance turn, three-quarter/back camera so BOTH human tearful face looking over shoulder and large back key are visible. Two blades incorporated into pose as representative DPS example, limbs visibly resisting control, bittersweet rather than happy dancer.

stages.title: 얼어붙은 혈관의 연금술사
stages.boss: Unselected healer1. Recognizably human healer drained of warmth, cold pallor; veins replaced by translucent glass conduits carrying SILVER mercury. Metallic tubes trace arms/neck/chest over protective costume, no graphic medical wounds.
stages.scene: 45m platinum-tiled gothic cryo-alchemy laboratory, SIX silver liquid floor channels, emerald healing circles on left/right (3 and9o'clock), cold glass vessels and lab arches.
stages.pose: Controlled tragic healer opening arms, silver conduits thread through forearms, one fragile emerging green healing light contrasting cold mercury; readable flask/alchemical kit as representative job cue. Compassion glimpsed beneath exhaustion.

stages.title: 영원히 타오르는 가마의 수호자
stages.boss: Unselected tank1, living human expedition shield bearer supporting furnace load, armor glazed by molten gold, bound by EIGHT thick red-hot cooling chains attached to shoulders/arms/torso support mounts, no impalement gore.
stages.scene: 45m OCTAGONAL metal-grate platform over molten GOLD sea inside huge clocktower furnace; eight cooling-chain pillars at corners.
stages.pose: A braced tank raising enormous shield to shelter companions behind, low three-quarter camera, face still human and resolute, eight chains pull radially to the background pillars. Convey 'I am your shield' rather than execution; no other characters required.

stages.title: 무너진 천구를 떠받치는 부단장
stages.boss: Same veteran vice-captain identity as actor reference: long pale lavender/silver hair, monocle, navy/ivory gold military coat, colossal golden HOUR-HAND SPEAR. Mad war wraith crushed by gravity and corruption; protective bodily instinct remains.
stages.scene: 45m black-obsidian star-chart arena, Roman I-IV broken/dark and V-XII blue, enormous brass astrolabe rings and frozen cosmos; collapsing celestial ceiling visibly burdens shoulders.
stages.pose: Kneeling/braced under enormous celestial arc, hour-hand spear planted to support load, free arm intercepts own attacking arm as if unconsciously shielding subordinates. Reference identity recognizable and all major arm connections clear. No actual self-injury gore.

stages.title: 구원받은 인형, 이리스
stages.boss: Same Iris actor identity: long wavy blonde hair, white/navy saint veil/dress and blue eyes. Corrupted PORCELAIN WHITE saint with EXACTLY SIX wings made of large sharp GOLDEN CLOCK HANDS (three per side), exposed mechanical clock HEART in chest behind separated porcelain rib armor. ANATOMICAL LEFT arm is giant attached golden blade, ANATOMICAL RIGHT remains fragile warm human hand.
stages.scene: 45m white-marble cathedral arena, sixty subtle golden second marks around edge, petrified teacups floating in air, soft cold white/gold light.
stages.pose: Full three-quarter figure with all six wings individually readable. Human RIGHT hand (screen-left in frontal view) crosses body to restrain LEFT blade arm (screen-right); cold doll smile with lingering sorrow. Center clock-heart visible. Elegant unsettling tragedy, not blood or nudity. Keep Iris face/hair/veil recognizable.

stages.title: 과거에 갇힌 선대 단장
stages.boss: Same human old captain identity as reference: warm blonde/white hair and full beard, gentle fatherly smile, navy cape, ivory gold command coat, colossal golden MINUTE-HAND GREATSWORD. Half body/arm dissolves into gold sand while he believes this is morning training.
stages.scene: 45m black MIRROR arena, giant minute hand stopped at11:59, floating mirror fragments reflecting warm blue-sky training-ground memories, cold dark present outside mirrors.
stages.pose: Welcoming open hand and gentle sparring stance with sword over shoulder or lowered safely; one side disintegrates into gold sand. Warm smiling living face vs tragic fractured reality, clear full silhouette. Mirrors show scenery, not extra solid bosses.

stages.title: 제13시의 신, 아페이론
stages.boss: True final Phase2 boss APEIRON, colossal pale divine cosmic entity with SHATTERED CLOCK DISK embedded in chest, unmistakable Roman XIII core. Crown/limbs formed of coherent celestial clock geometry, majestic terrifying scale. Not Kronos (Extreme hidden boss) and not generic evil knight.
stages.scene: 50m golden rooftop clock-face arena above clouds, Roman I-XII at edge; sky split between midnight cosmos with black solar eclipse and blinding golden dawn. A giant clock-hand bridge rises toward the XIII chest core.
stages.pose: Low wide three-quarter monumental shot, entire main divine silhouette and chest core dominate. One immense hand grasps a clock hand trying to turn time back; clock-hand bridge leads viewer toward core. No UI, no gore, no small foreground raid characters required.

notes: Stages5-7 are explicitly human companions according to latest scenario; never apply old 'all bosses nonhuman' notes to override this. Stage8 representative shot uses Apeiron, not separate Administrator or Extreme Kronos art. Only eight concept shots requested.
